subtitle_or_header:
May reach different minimum value based on:
initial point and learning rate

bullets: May reach different minimum value based on:

layout.arrangement: Title top-left; slide number in a yellow circle at the top-right; a small parameter box at the left-middle; the formula and explanatory annotation in the center; a function plot with a local-minimum callout at the right; a large numeric table across the bottom.

regions.name: Title block
regions.content: Red title 'Non-Convex Function' above a blue two-line subtitle.

regions.name: Parameter box
regions.content: Small bordered box with rows step/initial x/delta x and values 0.1/-11/0.1; a red block arrow points from it toward the table.

regions.name: Formula and annotation
regions.content: Fraction formula for f(x), then two annotation lines: 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6' (with '-9.6' in red bold) and 'f(x) is in between -8.08 and -8.011'.

regions.name: Function plot
regions.content: Green oscillating curve, red initial point, orange arrow to a green square local minimum, purple 'Reach Local Minima' callout.

regions.name: Numeric table
regions.content: Eight labeled rows and sixteen data columns showing x, f(x), x-delta, f(x-delta), x+delta, f(x+delta), slope, and next x.

layout.hierarchy: The red title is largest; the blue subtitle is second; the dense table dominates the lower half visually; the plot is the main graphic; the formula and annotation are smaller center text; the parameter box is smallest.

visual_elements.position: bottom center/right, spanning most of the slide width

visual_elements.description: Cartesian plot of the same non-convex function. Horizontal axis labeled x with ticks -12, -10, -8, -6, -4, -2; vertical axis labeled y with ticks 0, -2, -4, -6, -8, -10 and space above 0 for the initial point. A green curve oscillates through alternating local minima and maxima (exact count not derivable from this analysis). A red/orange dot marks the initial point near x=-11, y=1.15; a thick orange arrow follows the curve down to a green square marker at the first local minimum near x=-9.6, y=-8.11. A purple rounded label reads 'Reach Local Minima' with a purple pointer toward the green square.

Small parameter box with two columns and three rows: step | 0.1; initial x | -11; delta x | 0.1. Yellow #FFFF00 appears as an accent within the box (exact sub-element not specified in the source analysis).
Formula displayed as a fraction: numerator x^2 cos(x) - x, denominator 10, with f(x) on the left.

Two annotation lines: 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6' (with '-9.6' rendered in red bold) and 'f(x) is in between -8.08 and -8.011'. The second line literally shows -8.011 even though the table cell shows -8.11; this discrepancy is unresolved (see validation.uncertain_items).
Red block arrow from the parameter box pointing right/down toward the table.

imagery: No photos or external icons; the only illustration is the vector-style function plot described in visual_elements[1].
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout, likely Arial/Calibri; use one sans-serif family for the whole slide. Title is large bold red; subtitle is bold blue with 'initial point' in red and 'learning rate' in blue. In the center annotation, the value '-9.6' is red bold. Table text is small and dense; row labels are plain, numerals are compact. The formula uses italic math variables. No all-caps text; no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Static slide; no mid-build indicators. All table rows, the plot, and all callouts are fully visible.
recreation_brief: 1) Create a 16:9 slide with a solid light-gray background #F2F2F2 (no other background shape is specified). 2) Place a text box at top-left (x 3%-45%, y 6%-20%) with the title 'Non-Convex Function' in large bold red #FF0000 sans-serif. 3) Directly below the title, add two bold blue #0000FF subtitle lines: line 1 'May reach different minimum value based on:' and line 2 'initial point and learning rate', with the words 'initial point' in red #FF0000 and 'learning rate' in blue #0000FF. 4) At top-right (x 88%-97%, y 3%-12%), draw a yellow #FFFF00 circle with the black number '33' centered inside. 5) At left-middle (x 3%-18%, y 33%-50%), draw a small bordered 2-column by 3-row parameter table with black text on white #FFFFFF and a yellow #FFFF00 accent: rows 'step | 0.1', 'initial x | -11', 'delta x | 0.1'. 6) From the parameter box, draw a red #FF0000 block arrow pointing right/down toward the bottom table. 7) At center (x 38%-66%, y 32%-52%), typeset the formula f(x) = (x^2 cos(x) - x) / 10 in black as a stacked fraction (numerator 'x^2 cos(x) - x', denominator '10') with italic math variables. 8) Below the formula, add two black annotation lines: 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6' with '-9.6' in red #FF0000 bold, and 'f(x) is in between -8.08 and -8.011' reproduced exactly as extracted (note: -8.011 conflicts with the table value -8.11; see validation.uncertain_items). 9) Across the bottom (x 2%-98%, y 62%-95%), build a dense table with one label column plus 16 data columns and 8 rows using exactly these values - row 'x': -11, -10.9, -10.8, -10.7, -10.6, -10.5, -10.4, -10.3, -10.2, -10.1, -10, -9.9, -9.8, -9.7, -9.6, -9.5; row 'f(x)': 1.15, -0.04, -1.19, -2.26, -3.27, -4.19, -5.03, -5.77, -6.41, -6.95, -7.39, -7.72, -7.96, -8.08, -8.11, -8.05; row 'x-delta': -11.1, -11, -10.9, -10.8, -10.7, -10.6, -10.5, -10.4, -10.3, -10.2, -10.1, -10, -9.9, -9.8, -9.7, -9.6; row 'f(x-delta)': 2.39, 1.15, -0.04, -1.19, -2.26, -3.27, -4.19, -5.03, -5.77, -6.41, -6.95, -7.39, -7.72, -7.96, -8.08, -8.11; row 'x+delta': -10.9, -10.8, -10.7, -10.6, -10.5, -10.4, -10.3, -10.2, -10.1, -10, -9.9, -9.8, -9.7, -9.6, -9.5, -9.4; row 'f(x+delta)': -0.04, -1.19, -2.26, -3.27, -4.19, -5.03, -5.77, -6.41, -6.95, -7.39, -7.72, -7.96, -8.08, -8.11, -8.05, -7.89; row 'slope': -24.3, -23.4, -22.2, -20.8, -19.3, -17.6, -15.8, -13.8, -11.8, -9.8, -7.7, -5.7, -3.6, -1.5, 0.3, 2.2; row 'next x': -10.9, -10.8, -10.7, -10.6, -10.5, -10.4, -10.3, -10.2, -10.1, -10, -9.9, -9.8, -9.7, -9.6, -9.7, -9.6; fill the rows with alternating bands pale green #E2EFDA, pale blue #DDEBF7, pale purple #E4DFEC, pale peach #FCE4D6 over white #FFFFFF; highlight the two columns around the minimum (x=-9.7 and x=-9.6) in yellow #FFFF00; render the cells 'x = -9.6' and 'f(x) = -8.11' in red #FF0000 bold; keep all table text small and dense. 10) At right (x 64%-97%, y 24%-60%), draw a Cartesian line chart: black #000000 axes with the horizontal axis labeled 'x' and ticks -12, -10, -8, -6, -4, -2, the vertical axis labeled 'y' with ticks 0, -2, -4, -6, -8, -10 plus headroom above 0, and light-gray #D9D9D9 gridlines; add a purple #7030A0 rounded callout reading 'Reach Local Minima' with a pointer aimed at the green square.

fixes_applied: Removed the embedded style descriptor 'color red bold' from verbatim_text.bullets[2], visual_elements[4], and the 'Formula and annotation' region; the annotation line is now the clean text 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6', with '-9.6' red bold recorded as styling in typography_notes rather than as slide text.

Deleted the unsupported 'white content rectangle with a thick purple border' from recreation_brief step 1; no region, visual_element, or colors entry describes such a rectangle. The only specified background is light gray #F2F2F2.

Replaced the vague quantifier 'several local minima/maxima' in visual_elements[1] with 'alternating local minima and maxima'; no exact extremum count is derivable from the JSON (flagged in uncertain_items).

Made the table highlight precise in visual_elements[0] and recreation_brief: the two columns around the minimum (x=-9.7 and x=-9.6) are highlighted yellow #FFFF00 (the only unassigned color in the table palette), and the cells x=-9.6 and f(x)=-8.11 are red #FF0000 bold, replacing the vague 'cells around the minimum are highlighted'.
Corrected the self-contradictory typography note 'No all-caps text except none' to 'No all-caps text'.

Rewrote recreation_brief as a 10-step ordered checklist; each step places exactly one element with its verbatim text, region-derived position, hex color, and shape/chart type, and embeds the complete 8-row by 16-column table data.

Verified coverage: all 15 verbatim labels map to regions (step/initial x/delta x -> parameter box; x, f(x), x-delta, f(x-delta), x+delta, f(x+delta), slope, next x -> table rows; x, y -> plot axes; 'Reach Local Minima' -> plot callout; 33 -> slide-number circle), and all 7 visual_elements fall inside the 6 layout.regions.
uncertain_items: The annotation 'f(x) is in between -8.08 and -8.011' shows -8.011, which conflicts with the table value -8.11 at x=-9.6 (and with f(-9.6) computed from the equation, approximately -8.115). The source analysis itself flags this. Kept verbatim as extracted; verify against the source video frame before final render.
Reconstruction of annotation line 1 as 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6' assumes 'color red bold' was an OCR style descriptor that leaked into the text, not literal slide text.
Which sub-element of the parameter box carries the yellow #FFFF00 accent (border, header, or fill) is not specified in the source analysis.

The exact row-to-color mapping of the four pastel band fills (#E2EFDA, #DDEBF7, #E4DFEC, #FCE4D6) across the 8 table rows is not enumerated; the brief assumes alternating row bands per the original analysis.
The exact number of oscillation extrema visible in the green curve is not derivable; the brief specifies the curve by its equation over the tick range x=-12 to -2 instead.

The highlighted 'cells around the minimum' are interpreted as the x=-9.7 and x=-9.6 columns, inferred from the annotation 'X is in between -9.7 and -9.6'; the exact highlighted cell set is not enumerated in the source.
